description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Idempotency feature in the Apache Fineract project. It primarily tests the behavior of updating the order of business steps within a job, ensuring correct handling of idempotency keys, caching, and response consistency.

classes.name: IdempotencyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the idempotency behavior of business step order updates in the Fineract project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: shouldUpdateStepOrder
methods.description: Tests updating the business steps order multiple times with the same idempotency key, ensuring correct caching and idempotent behavior.

methods.name: shouldTheSecondRequestWithSameIdempotencyKeyWillFailureToo
methods.description: Ensures that making a second request with the same idempotency key produces an appropriate error response, confirming idempotency enforcement.

methods.name: getBusinessSteps
methods.description: Helper method to create a BusinessStep object with specified order and name.
